notes: Mathematical target: the Spencer/filtered cohomology class obstructing an endpoint-normalized invariant differential chain lift.

Candidate theorem: finite-type stabilizer jets and the prolonged top-descent equations force the normalized defect class to survive every finite order in the fixed local carrier; alternatively the spectral sequence identifies a first page and degree on which a legal transgression kills it.

Proof obligations: define symbol modules and differentials invariantly; prove formal integrability or locate its failure; identify the defect class and its prolongations; show basis/presentation independence; separate a fixed-family theorem from repairs that change the problem.

Counterexample strategy: reproduce the exact order-one, order-two, and order-three verdicts as low-degree consequences; mutate endpoint/current incidence and require the cohomology class or page differential to change; directly substitute any claimed first-order-of-relief construction.

Certificate boundary: an all-finite-order result is allowed only for the explicitly fixed endpoint-normalized invariant support-local family. It is not a no-go for different currents, endpoints, carriers, nonlocal maps, causal constructions, or quantum theory.
